biological.citation: PIM1-HDAC2 axis modulates intestinal homeostasis through epigenetic modification (PMID: 39027246)
biological.summary: HDAC2 is a direct interacting partner of PIM1 kinase in intestinal epithelial cells. PIM1 phosphorylates and downregulates HDAC2 levels, which alters epigenetic profiles of Wnt signaling pathway genes and impairs goblet cell differentiation during colitis pathogenesis.
biological.sample_size: Ulcerative colitis patients and murine models

biological.citation: HDAC2 promotes autophagy-associated HCC malignant progression by transcriptionally activating LAPTM4B (PMID: 39147759)
biological.summary: HDAC2 acts as a transcriptional activator that binds to the LAPTM4B promoter at four distinct sites to enhance its transcription and promote autophagy-driven hepatocellular carcinoma progression. High HDAC2 expression correlates with poor HCC prognosis and is an independent predictor of patient outcomes.

biological.citation: N6-methyladenosine-modified SENP1, identified by IGF2BP3, is a novel molecular marker in acute myeloid leukemia and aggravates progression by activating AKT signal via de-SUMOylating HDAC2 (PMID: 38822351)
biological.summary: HDAC2 is a direct substrate of SENP1 deSUMOylase. SENP1 removes SUMO modifications from HDAC2, which enhances EGFR transcription and activates the AKT/mTOR signaling pathway to promote AML proliferation and anti-apoptosis.
biological.sample_size: AML patient datasets (OHSU, TCGA, TARGET, MILE)

biological.citation: YTHDC1 is downregulated by the YY1/HDAC2 complex and controls the sensitivity of ccRCC to sunitinib by targeting the ANXA1-MAPK pathway (PMID: 35974388)
biological.summary: HDAC2 functions as part of a YY1/HDAC2 transcriptional repressor complex that downregulates YTHDC1 expression in clear cell renal cell carcinoma. This axis modulates sensitivity to tyrosine kinase inhibitors through the ANXA1/MAPK pathway, and HDAC2 inhibitors can resensitize resistant tumors.

HDAC2 is a cellular fitness factor that controls cell cycle progression and metastatic dissemination in undifferentiated, mesenchymal pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. HDAC2 maintains expression of prosurvival receptor tyrosine kinases (PDGFRα, PDGFRβ, EGFR) and disables the tumor-suppressive TGFβ pathway.

biological.citation: Damascenone inhibits osteoclastogenesis by epigenetically modulating Nrf2-mediated ROS scavenge and counteracts OVX-induced osteoporosis (PMID: 39547093)
biological.summary: HDAC2 is identified as a direct target of the natural compound damascenone. Damascenone inhibits HDAC2 function and increases H3K27ac histone acetylation at the Nrf2 promoter, inducing Nrf2 expression and ROS scavenging to suppress osteoclastogenesis in vitro and in vivo.

biological.citation: HRD1-mediated ubiquitination of HDAC2 regulates PPARα-mediated autophagy and alleviates metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (PMID: 38815686)
biological.summary: HDAC2 is a substrate of the E3 ubiquitin ligase HRD1 and acts as a transcriptional repressor of PPARα. HRD1-mediated ubiquitin-proteasomal degradation of HDAC2 relieves PPARα repression and promotes hepatic autophagy to alleviate hypoxia-induced metabolic-associated fatty liver disease.

biological.citation: Emerging roles and therapeutic implications of HDAC2 and IL-17A in steroid-resistant asthma (PMID: 39170824)
biological.summary: HDAC2 activity is significantly reduced in patients with severe asthma and smoking-induced asthma, leading to increased acetylation of glucocorticoid receptors and amplified expression of inflammatory genes. Restoring HDAC2 activity is proposed as a therapeutic approach to reverse steroid insensitivity.
biological.sample_size: Severe asthma and smoking-induced asthma patients

biological.citation: Histone deacetylase-mediated silencing of PSTPIP2 expression contributes to aristolochic acid nephropathy-induced PANoptosis (PMID: 38073114)
biological.summary: HDAC2 expression is upregulated in aristolochic acid-induced kidney injury and mediates transcriptional silencing of PSTPIP2. HDAC1/HDAC2-specific inhibitor romidepsin suppresses aristolochic acid-induced PANoptosis (pyroptosis, apoptosis, necroptosis) by upregulating PSTPIP2 and regulating caspase 8.
biological.sample_size: Mouse kidney and renal tubular epithelial cells

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Systematic analysis of nonsense-mediated decay escaping protein-truncating variants in 97,728 clinical exomes identifies new Mendelian disease genes
biological.summary: HDAC2 was identified as a candidate gene for neurodevelopmental disorders through systematic analysis of nonsense-mediated decay-escaping protein-truncating variants. Two patients with syndromic neurodevelopmental delay carried de novo PTVesc mutations in HDAC2, suggesting loss-of-function variants in this histone modifier cause developmental disease.

biological.citation: ASHG 2018 - Large-scale trans-ethnic genome-wide association study reveals novel loci, causal molecular mechanisms and effector genes for kidney function
biological.summary: HDAC2 binding sites are significantly enriched in eGFR (estimated glomerular filtration rate) association signals across 312,468 individuals of diverse ancestry. Class I histone deacetylases including HDAC2 are required for embryonic kidney gene expression, growth and differentiation.
biological.significance: p < 5×10⁻⁸ for multiple loci; enrichment analysis p < 0.00039
